FIELDS.NAME: Adventure Gear Outfitters
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Adventure Gear Outfitters specializes in retailing a wide range of high-quality camping and outdoor recreational equipment. Our core operations focus on providing customers with expert guidance and education about our products, including hiking gear, tents, sleeping bags, and outdoor cooking equipment. We pride ourselves on maintaining strong vendor relationships and comply with all necessary safety and regulatory standards to ensure customer safety. Our store features in-store instructional activities that promote the responsible use of outdoor equipment, and we conduct regular staff training sessions to enhance product knowledge. We have implemented advanced security measures, such as monitored burglar alarms, to protect our inventory and provide a safe shopping experience. Our inventory management system allows us to effectively evaluate product exposure and manage seasonal offerings, ensuring that we meet the diverse needs of our customers while maintaining compliance with all relevant laws.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, we experienced a theft at our retail location where unknown individuals broke in and stole camping gear valued at $5,000. The incident was reported to the local police, and we've implemented enhanced security measures since. The claim is currently pending review with our insurance provider. Additionally, a water leak on May 25, 2023, caused damage to our inventory totaling $2,500, which has been resolved and covered by our insurance.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Sunday 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-Security Safes, UL Class 3501, Fire and Burglary Resistant, Rated for Cash and Valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: High-security fencing and 24/7 surveillance system installed to enhance protection against theft and unauthorized access.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in any of its operations. The focus is strictly on retailing camping and outdoor recreational equipment.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not sponsor any athletic teams. Our focus is primarily on retailing outdoor equipment and providing educational resources to our customers.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters requires all subcontractors to provide a certificate of insurance before commencing work to ensure proper risk transfer. The management team is responsible for checking and verifying these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters has not experienced any policies or coverage that were declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. The business has maintained consistent insurance coverage and has proactively managed its risks.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain our own staff to ensure dedicated service and expertise in the retail of outdoor equipment.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Adventure Gear Outfitters carries Workers' Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements and ensure the safety and protection of our employees. This policy is active and in place prior to the inception date of our current coverage.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on retailing camping and outdoor recreational equipment.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters currently holds one policy with this company (policy number AG-2023-ADVENTURE-01) and does not maintain any additional insurance.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the retail of camping and outdoor recreational equipment.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its operations, thus minimizing liability and compliance risks associated with equipment rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The business maintains a strong financial standing and has managed its operations responsibly.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations are strictly focused on retailing camping and outdoor recreational equipment without handling hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus solely on retailing camping and outdoor recreational equipment without engaging in activities that would increase such risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to ethical hiring practices and workplace safety.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Adventure Gear Outfitters does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. We ensure regular inspections and compliance with all fire safety regulations.
